Fresh score. Critics Consensus Like many classic games, Jumanji: The Next Level retains core components of what came before while adding enough fresh bits to keep things playable. Read Critics Reviews Page 1 of 4, 7 total items. Stephen Romei The Australian 01/11/2020 Content collapsed. The fun and games come with seeing who becomes who. It's made even funnier this time around... Go to Full Review Roxana Hadadi Chesapeake Family Magazine 12/27/2019 Content collapsed. With thoughtful questions about the transition from adolescence to young adulthood and adulthood to retirement, Jumanji: The Next Level is an enjoyable return to this world. Go to Full Review Chris Stuckmann ChrisStuckmann.com 12/20/2019 Content collapsed. It's a well-paced movie. Go to Full Review Eddie Harrison film-authority.com Jun 11 Content collapsed. ... fairly indistinguishable from the previous film. Aimed specifically as small kids, Jake Kasdan’s sequel manages to remove some of the crude sexism of the previous entry, but there’s little improvement in the overall Jumanji package.... Go to Full Review David Griffiths Subculture Entertainment 10/29/2024 Content collapsed. The film has the right mix of drama, comedy and action and contains one of the best ensemble casts we’ve seen on the big screen for a long time. Go to Full Review Rolando Gallego EscribiendoCine 12/28/2022 Content collapsed. Great family fun that leans into the solid performances by Jack Black (as always), Dwayne Johnson (laughing at himself), Kevin Hart, Nick Jonas, and Awkwafina as they explore the film's playful and adventurous spirit with humor. Jumanji: The Next Level: Trailer 1 2:40 View more videos View more videos Synopsis When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But the game is now broken -- and fighting back. Everything the friends know about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover there are more obstacles and more danger to overcome.
